mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_audit_log ( event_id, schema_version, source_code, category_path_snapshot, app_code_snapshot, tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, subject_username_snapshot, subject_display_name_snapshot, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, action_code, action_name_snapshot, target_type, target_id, target_name_snapshot, target_code_snapshot, reason, result, failure_reason_code, masked_mobile, trace_id, occurred_time, duration_ms, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{sourceCode}, CAST(#{categoryPathJson} AS jsonb), #{appCodeSnapshot}, #{tenantId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorUsernameSnapshot}, #{operatorDisplayNameSnapshot}, #{operatorUsernameSnapshot}, #{operatorDisplayNameSnapshot}, #{actionCode}, #{actionNameSnapshot}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetNameSnapshot}, #{targetCodeSnapshot}, #{reason}, #{result}, #{failureReasonCode}, #{maskedMobile}, #{traceId}, #{occurredTime}, #{durationMs}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.auth_audit_log ( tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, subject_username_snapshot, subject_display_name_snapshot, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, action_code, action_name_snapshot, result, login_method, device_summary, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.subjectType}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.subjectType}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{username}, COALESCE(#{displayName}, #{username}), #{username}, COALESCE(#{displayName}, #{username}), #{actionCode}, #{actionNameSnapshot}, 'SUCCESS', #{entity.loginMethod}, LEFT(CONCAT(#{entity.deviceType}, ' / ', #{entity.deviceName}), 256), #{traceId}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.subjectId} )

INSERT INTO public.auth_audit_log ( tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, subject_username_snapshot, subject_display_name_snapshot, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, action_code, action_name_snapshot, result, login_method, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', #{accountId}, 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', #{accountId}, #{username}, COALESCE(#{displayName}, #{username}), #{username}, COALESCE(#{displayName}, #{username}), 'auth:password:reset:sms', '手机号验证码自助重置密码', 'SUCCESS', 'SMS', #{traceId}, #{accountId}, #{accountId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, subject_username_snapshot, subject_display_name_snapshot, operator_type, operator_id, operator_username_snapshot, operator_display_name_snapshot, action_code, action_name_snapshot, result, login_method, failure_reason_code, masked_mobile, device_summary, trace_id, occurred_time, app_code_snapshot, category_path_snapshot::text AS category_path_json, target_type, target_id, target_name_snapshot, target_code_snapshot, reason, duration_ms FROM public.auth_audit_log WHERE ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
